==Description==
'''v1.0.1''' is the thirty-first update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 26th of January 2022. It removed the [[Solar Eclipse Event]] and made a few game improvements.

This update added the in-game numbering system.

This version encompassed two updates, the main v1.0.1 update (released 26 January 2022) and the minor v1.0.1a update (released 26 January 2022).

==Additions==

*New lobby

==Changes & Bugfixes==
*New loading screen.
*New update log UI.
**Now has a numbering system.
*Players below {{Level|50}} can now purchase {{Gem|Gems}}.
*[[Executioner]] gamepass taken offsale.
*Fixed [[Abyssal Trench]] not having a blue filter.

:In '''v1.0.1a''':
*[[Executioner]] is now available through a gamepass for {{Robux|750}}.
